# RBC Capital Markets / RBC Clear (U.S. 3 WFC Branch) — United States

Verified 2026-10-11. Publisher: commercial-bank.

**Documented market:** Current 2026 MRS FAQ explicitly says all products/services and deposit accounts are in the United States, offered from 3 WFC Branch; non-U.S. clients use U.S. products cross-border.

**Formats / versions:** camt.052 v2; camt.053 v2; camt.054 v8

## Scope and source notes

Live corporate 052 v2 intraday and 053 v2 end-of-day statements through SFTP and Swift FileAct; 054 v8 event-driven debit/credit notifications through SFTP, FileAct and FINplus. End-of-day covers transactions through 9 PM ET and is available by 10 PM ET. Enrollment/connectivity setup required. Detailed statement formatting guides are explicitly client-gated in RBC Clear insights / Connectivity / Developer Portal; testing requires account manager. Exact namespace suffixes and public original XML samples were not independently established. Separate from Canadian RBC Express. No open redistribution license established.

[Publisher usage terms](https://www.rbc.com/legal/).
